description: Pannellum is a lightweight, free, and open source panorama viewer for the web.

latest_release.name: Pannellum 2.5.7
latest_release.body:
Security fixes:
 - Fixed XSS vulnerability regarding hot spot attributes that allowed script execution without any user interaction other than visiting the standalone viewer from a link that pointed to a malicious JSON config file (CVE-2026-27210)
 - Require same-origin for JSON config file for standalone viewer to mitigate XSS risk
 - Sanitize load error URLs
